gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped-metal lowercase, tall and single-stroke, sits under Wallpoet's high-rising letters with paper showing through every line. Hind Guntur moves along steadily, never changing pressure.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-madurai: Hard-edged and loud, Wallpoet rises high with a thin gap of paper cutting through its letters. Hind Madurai answers in plain sans with wide-open s curves and lowercase that fills the line, making long reading feel smooth.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru reads crisply, its lowercase pressing up near the ascender height and each a left slightly ajar. Hind Mysuru handles the paragraphs while Wallpoet handles the shouting, its smooth bends and see-through lines made for a big entrance.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-vadodara: Commanding up top, Wallpoet carves smooth bends with paper showing through its lines. Hind Vadodara takes over in sans-serif with uniform strokes and spacious openings, so a long stretch of text moves along without snags.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-huninn: Huninn keeps its letters tidy and tall. Wallpoet brings the swagger, so give the body some generous size to let those bent-paperclip lines and clear s terminals breathe.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-inter-tight: Wallpoet storms in with high-rising lowercase and gaps where the paper shows, while Inter Tight tucks short ascenders under it. Next to the heading, the plain sans feels like tubing beside a billboard.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-karla: Wallpoet cuts its bends smooth and lets paper peek through the lines, a bold, commanding opening. Karla comes in stocky and approachable, its tall middle band and gaping c giving the text a friendlier footing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-kedebideri: Lines split by slivers of paper show off Wallpoet's smooth curves and high-rising lowercase, all bold and commanding at once. Kedebideri then adds a skyward x-height in rounded, inviting plain sans shapes.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-khula: Khula reads with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open, modern and easygoing. Khula takes the quiet work of the text, while Wallpoet gives its smooth, high-rising lettering to the loud moments.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-krub: Krub stands tall with a pronounced x-height. Wallpoet gives the pair its bold, commanding edge, and Krub's pen-lifted curves leave their loops unfinished, which feels breezy beside those smooth, paper-striped letters.
